fact: 1900年巴黎世界博览会于4月14日至11月12日举行，国际展览局记载参观人次5100万、参展者超过8万，是当年全球最大规模的人员、商品与技术集会之一。

sources.title: Expo 1900 Paris
sources.quote: the fifth Exposition Universelle to be held in Paris gathered 51 million visitors between 14 April and 12 November 1900, and registered more than 80,000 participants.

fact: 1900年巴黎奥运会作为世界博览会的一部分举行，开始日期为5月14日；国际奥委会当前页面将结束日期列为10月29日，大英百科列为10月28日，来源之间存在一天差异。

sources.title: Olympic Games Paris 1900
sources.quote: Date14 May - 29 October. The Games of 1900 were held in Paris as part of the World’s Fair.

sources.title: Paris 1900 Olympic Games | Britannica
sources.quote: Paris 1900 Olympic Games, athletic festival held in Paris that took place May 14–October 28, 1900.

fact: 第二次布尔战争自1899年10月11日持续至1902年5月31日；1900年金伯利、莱迪史密斯和马弗京相继解围，战争新闻成为英国本土和帝国金融市场的重要情绪变量。

sources.title: South African War | Britannica
sources.quote: On October 9, 1899, they issued an ultimatum to British government, declaring that a state of war would exist between Britain and the two Boer

sources.title: The Second Boer War 1899-1902
sources.quote: The Boer Republics declared war on 11th October 1899 and the conflict ended on 31st May 1902, a duration of 2 years and 8 months.

fact: 《德国民法典》和《德国商法典》于1900年1月1日同时生效，德意志帝国境内开始适用统一的民事与商事规则；合同、物权和公司制度由此具有更统一的法律框架。

sources.title: Bürgerliches Gesetzbuch – Wikipedia（德文）
sources.quote: Das 1896 beschlossene und ausgefertigte BGB trat am 1. Januar 1900 gemäß Art. 1 EGBGB in Kraft.

sources.title: Universität Mannheim, Handelsrecht-Vorlesungsfolien
sources.quote: Handelsgesetzbuch (HGB) vom 10. Mai 1897 ... Inkrafttreten am 1. Januar 1900 (gleichzeitig mit dem BGB)

fact: 《日英通商航海条约》自1899年7月17日生效，结束英国在日本的领事裁判权，在日英国臣民改受日本法律管辖；1900年的外国人在日法律环境已不同于旧条约口岸时代。

sources.title: Anglo-Japanese Treaty of Commerce and Navigation
sources.quote: When this treaty became effective, British subjects in Japan became subject to Japanese laws instead of British laws. The jurisdiction of the British Supreme Court for China and Japan, the British Court for Japan under it and consular courts in each treaty port ceased on that date, save for pending cases which were allowed to continue.

sources.title: Beyond the Treaty Limits: Pushing the Boundaries in Meiji Japan（Cobbing, Japanese Studies 2025）
sources.quote: As a result, in 1899 the Treaty Limits were no more, and foreigners no longer needed to obtain passports before venturing inland.

fact: 美国1900年3月14日《金本位法》把美元定义为23.22格令纯金，约合每盎司黄金20.67美元，并维持所有流通货币与该标准等值，白银复本位争论由此告一段落。

sources.title: Gold Standard Act of 1900 法条原文
sources.quote: That the dollar consisting of twenty-five and eight-tenths grains of gold nine-tenths fine ... shall be the standard unit of value, and all forms of money issued or coined by the United States shall be maintained at a parity of value with this standard.

sources.title: Peterson Institute — The US Gold Standard and the International Monetary System
sources.quote: The Currency Act of 1900, also known as the Gold Standard Act, established an official American mono-metallic gold standard with a dollar worth 23.22 grains of pure gold.

fact: 日本1897年《货币法》改行金本位，规定纯金0.75克等于1日元，新币制自1897年10月1日实施；1900年的日本对外贸易与金融结算建立在金本位日元之上。

sources.title: Currency Museum, Bank of Japan — History of Currency
sources.quote: In 1897, Japan enacted the “Currency Act” to introduce the gold standard system, and stipulated that 0.75 g of gold was equivalent to one yen.

sources.title: Lever of Empire: The International Gold Standard and the Crisis of Liberalism in Prewar Japan
sources.quote: In March 1897 the new Coinage Law put the yen on a gold standard as of October 1897, with a value of o-75 grams of gold.

fact: 俄国维特1895—1897年货币改革确立金本位；1897年8月29日法令规定国家银行纸币由国家黄金储备支持并可自由兑换黄金，1900年的卢布是可与黄金兑换的稳定结算货币。

sources.title: Money of the Russian Revolution: 1917-1920（Cambridge Scholars Publishing 样章）
sources.quote: The 1895–97 monetary reform of S.Yu.Witte ... resulted in 1899 in a new set of monetary regulations ... The "gold standard" had been introduced. According to an edict of 29 August 1897, paper banknotes issued by the State Bank ... were backed by the state gold reserve, and could be freely exchanged for gold.

sources.title: Mr Ruble. The origin and evolution of Russia's national currency | UNESCO
sources.quote: Sergey Witte's reform (1895–1897) introduced the gold standard, backing the ruble with gold and making credit notes fully convertible to gold.

fact: 普林斯顿大学关于1900—1913年关键货币的研究指出，大部分私人国际结算使用英镑、法国法郎和德国马克，而非直接搬运黄金；伦敦、巴黎和柏林构成当时的关键货币中心。

sources.title: Key Currencies and Gold 1900-1913, Peter H. Lindert
sources.quote: It is common knowledge that most private international settlements were conducted in sterling, French francs, and German marks rather than in gold.

fact: 1900联邦财年获准进入美国的移民为448572人；外国人通常须在美居留满五年，并在提交归化意向声明后至少再等两年才能完成入籍，短期入境者不能依赖快速归化取得身份。

sources.title: Statistical Abstract of the United States, 37th ed. (1914) — 移民统计表
Iowa and the Nation（同时代教科书）
